command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(hostname)" = ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein
test "$USER" = ai-core-node
export LOCAL_BRIDGE_MACHINE_ID=ai-core-node
export LOCAL_BRIDGE_OWNER=gabriel
export FRANK_VOICE_DEFAULT_INSTALLATION=gabriel
export PYTHONPATH=$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import voice_action_executor as v
prompt=(
  'This is a production acceptance probe for Frankenstein Voice. '
  'Act as the worker. Use the Bash tool yourself now to execute exactly this harmless command: '
  'printf VOICE_FULL_ACTION_OK . Do not create or modify files. '
  'After the tool succeeds, answer with VOICE_FULL_ACTION_OK and nothing else.'
)
r=v.claude_frage_full(prompt,None,timeout=180)
print('RESULT_OK',r.get('ok'))
print('VOICE_PLANE',r.get('voice_full_action_plane'))
print('ANSWER',repr(r.get('antwort')) )
print('SESSION_PRESENT',bool(r.get('session_id')))
if not r.get('ok'): raise SystemExit('executor failed: '+str(r.get('grund') or r))
if 'VOICE_FULL_ACTION_OK' not in str(r.get('antwort') or ''): raise SystemExit('acceptance marker missing')
print('VOICE_ACTION_E2E_PASS')
PY
# confirm production service remained healthy during the independent worker probe
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service
systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID -p ExecStart -p Environment
echo E2E_HOST_PASS
